# United States Department of Justice

> > Official website of the U.S. Department of Justice, enforcing federal law and administering justice through agencies including the FBI, DEA, ATF, and Executive Office for Immigration Review.

The DOJ serves as the federal government's chief law enforcement agency, headed by the Attorney General. The department oversees criminal investigations, immigration proceedings, federal prosecutions, and provides legal guidance to the executive branch while protecting civil rights and national security.

## Key Topics

- Department of Justice (DOJ)
- Attorney General of the United States
- Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)
- Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR)
- Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF)
- Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)
- Federal law enforcement
- Immigration review and appeals
- Crime reporting
- Justice Manual
- Press releases and announcements
- Robert F. Kennedy Building (DOJ headquarters)
- Board of Immigration Appeals
- Federal prosecutions
- Civil rights enforcement

## Core Information

- [Department of Justice Homepage](https://www.justice.gov/): Official DOJ homepage with news, crime reporting, and federal law enforcement
- [About DOJ](https://www.justice.gov/about): About DOJ: mission, history, values, and organizational components
- [Office of the Attorney General](https://www.justice.gov/ag): Office of Attorney General Pamela Bondi: leadership and press releases

## Law Enforcement Agencies

- [Federal Bureau of Investigation](https://www.justice.gov/doj/federal-bureau-investigation): FBI organizational structure, history, and federal law enforcement role

## Immigration Services

- [EOIR Portal Help](https://portal.eoir.justice.gov/Help): Help documentation for ECAS and EOIR immigration portal resources
- [Automated Case Information System (ACIS)](http://acis.eoir.justice.gov/en/): ACIS: Immigration case status lookup for Board of Immigration Appeals

## Resources and Tools

- [DOJ Resources](https://www.justice.gov/resources): DOJ resources including Justice Manual, publications, and legal tools
- [Government Forms](https://www.justice.gov/forms): Directory of government forms from DOJ, BOP, ATF, and other agencies

## Contact and Support

- [Contact the Department](https://www.justice.gov/contact-us): Contact information for DOJ, Attorney General, and Office of Public Affairs
